_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars/forks/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: Red-teams RAG pipelines for the attacks eval frameworks miss: indirect prompt injection, source-document leakage, and cross-document smuggling. Runs as a CLI and a CI gate.
A Kubernetes remediation agent whose only write surface is a git commit, so undoing it is git revert. Six typed, reversible actions with a computable blast radius.
A DeltaRAG and Graph-RAG platform turning 10 live Android security and CVE feeds into evidence-backed risk tickets with a Sentinel scoring agent.
An 8-microservice platform on AWS EKS with zero-downtime deploys, automated with Jenkins and ArgoCD behind Trivy and SonarQube security gates.
